searchText: one possible mitigation to losing redeployable contracts would be to leave some time for contract owners to redeploy a forwarding contract before implementing the neutering, right? Yeah, I guess so. Someone could even make a tool to do the job automatically in cases when the contract can be redeployed with arbitrary new code.
